name: Gentlemen, It Is With Great Pleasure To Inform You That
look: A painted portrait of a toad dressed as an old-fashioned gentleman. He sits in a wooden chair in a black tailcoat, olive waistcoat and white cravat, staring forward with solemn, puffed-up dignity against a muddy yellow-green background.
use: The toad makes a formal, self-important announcement. The caption opens with "Gentlemen, it is with great pleasure to inform you that" and ends with some trivial or silly news delivered as if it were a grand occasion.
slots: top: Gentlemen, it is with great pleasure to inform you that
examples: Gentlemen, it is with great pleasure to inform you that
The vending machine has been restocked
Gentlemen, it is with great pleasure to inform you that
I have found the TV remote. It was in the fridge.
